stories.summary: The HackerNews community overwhelmingly rejects the push for AI agent compatibility, favoring instead strategies to protect content, preserve direct user engagement, and block scraping. Key tactics include leveraging interactive elements (e.g., JavaScript widgets) to force traffic back to their sites, celebrating 403 errors as a win, and viewing AI agent 'readiness' as a threat to revenue models.
